title: I'm a huge Apple fan - but there are 9 big reasons why I'm not buying the HomePod (AAPL)
text: I’m a huge Apple fan — but there are 9 big reasons why I’m not buying the HomePod (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Feb 12, 2018, 8:47 pm 16 pts I wouldn’t call myself an Apple loyalist, exactly — even though I'm typing these words on my MacBook while listening to music on my Beats wireless headphones. (I have an iPhone and and Apple Watch, too.) It’s just that a few years ago I decided that if I wanted a new gadget, it was easiest to…
